title: Crazy Gopalan
desc: Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.

title: Joseph
desc: Following the death of his ex-wife, a retired police officer, who is known for his investigative prowess, unexpectedly gets pulled into a criminal case involving organ harvesting.

title: Top Gear
desc: Arjun, a taxi driver, finds himself in trouble when one of his customers turns out to be a drug dealer. When the kingpin kidnaps Arjun's wife, he strives to save her.

title: The Book of Mythical Beasts
desc: When a ball of fire hits the Earth, it brings with it a mythical beast who wreaks havoc on humanity. In this battle between the beast and humans, will humanity survive?

title: Kabali
desc: A man spends 25 years in prison for fighting against oppression. Old but still bloodthirsty, he decides to seek revenge against his enemies upon his release.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Aranmanai
desc: A family returns to their hometown to sell their ancestral palace. However, their arrival is marred by supernatural events, and Ravi, a relative of the family, decides to uncover the truth.
